   1 class_name InputSystem extends System

  15 	if _last_tick != runtime.tick_index:
  16 		_last_tick = runtime.tick_index
  17 		_edges.clear()

  19 			var action: String = event.action
  20 			var pressed: bool = event.pressed
  21 			if pressed and not _held.get(action, false):
  22 				_edges[action] = true
  23 			_held[action] = pressed
  24 	var playing: bool = runtime.session.mode == "playing"
  25 	for entity in entities:

  30 			continue
  31 		input.axis = float(_held.get("move_right", false)) - float(_held.get("move_left", false)) if playing else 0.0

  33 		input.jump_held = playing and _held.get("jump", false)
  34 		input.sword_pressed = playing and _edges.get("sword", false)
  35 		input.card_pressed = playing and _edges.get("card", false)
  36 		input.dodge_pressed = playing and _edges.get("dodge", false)
  37 		input.interact_pressed = playing and _edges.get("interact", false)
  38 		input.ui_actions.clear()

  40 			if _edges.get(action, false):
  41 				input.ui_actions.append(action)
  42 
  43 func clear_actions() -> void:

  45 	_edges.clear()
